title: How Do Video Foundation Models Encode Intuitive Physics? Probing Across Pretraining Paradigms
venue: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models in Physical AI (poster)
summary: Probes whether physical plausibility is decodable from frozen video foundation model features (V-JEPA, VideoMAE, LTX-Video) using linear, MLP and attentive probes on Minimal Video Pairs and IntPhys2.

title: Mind the Gap: Promises and Pitfalls of Hierarchical Planning in LeWorldModel
venue: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Pretrained Agents, and Workshop on World Models at Chicago Booth 2026
summary: Adds a high-level macro-action planner to LeWorldModel and shows that naive hierarchy can underperform flat planning; constraining the search to macro-actions seen in training makes hierarchy useful at longer horizons.

title: AUEB NLP Group at ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2025
venue: CLEF 2025 Working Notes, CEUR Workshop Proceedings, Madrid
summary: The team's approach to the ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2025 challenge, placing 1st in Concept Detection, 1st in Explainability and 5th in Caption Prediction.
